name: AIAvatar
description: Guild AI agent identity — three concentric BRAND blue rings (#B4BDFF → #5A6DFF → #1F2A66) with white cross-star monogram. AIAvatar 34px, BotAvatar 18px. No orange gradient ring.
intent: Presentational fixed-color SVG. Same structure for both exports; only size, optional drop-shadow, and a11y differ. Do not theme-adapt fills for dark mode.

variants.name: AIAvatar
variants.when: Same three rings + monogram; optional blue `drop-shadow` on SVG

variants.name: BotAvatar
variants.when: **Identical SVG structure** — smaller size; no drop-shadow; `aria-hidden`

requiredAttributes: AIAvatar: aria-label on SVG (e.g. Guild Agent)
BotAvatar: aria-hidden when message text attributes speaker

usage: `AIAvatar` (34px) — bot identity in hero idle state of AI Command Center
`BotAvatar` (18px) — inline attribution beside AI response text
`AIAvatar3D` — dimensional BRAND blue variant when product spec requires dimensional treatment (separate asset)
doNotUse: Generic icon or decoration without AI context
Custom sizes outside **34px** and **18px** without design review
**Do not** add an orange gradient ring or recolor rings outside the BRAND ramp — the mark must read as BRAND blue
**Do not** theme-adapt ring fills to dark mode — see **Presentation & theme** below
Do not use without AI context
Do not add orange gradient ring or linearGradient
Do not use useId() for gradients — component has no gradients
Do not theme-adapt ring fills for dark mode — use fixed BRAND hex
Do not use currentColor on circles or monogram
Do not invent sizes outside 34px and 18px without design review
Do not treat BotAvatar as structurally different from AIAvatar — same SVG, different default size
Do not theme-adapt ring fills for dark mode
